summary.headline: Puravankara Q4 FY26 presales rose 190% YoY to INR3,547 crore; FY27 presales guidance set at INR11,200 crore and debt reduction target of INR750 crore.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 was a strong quarter on sales and handovers, with presales of INR3,547 crore (up 190% YoY and 151% QoQ) and total income of INR1,541 crore (up 173% YoY) driven by 1,301 handovers. FY26 presales hit a record INR7,407 crore (up 55%) and collections a record INR4,258 crore (up 15%). Net debt was INR2,321 crore at March 31, 2026, down INR160 crore in the quarter, and cost of debt fell to 11.05%. Management guided FY27 presales of INR11,200 crore and a gross debt reduction of about INR750 crore, excluding new borrowing for business development. Collections, interest cost and FY27 delivery guidance drew the most pointed questions and several were deferred to offline follow-up.

segments.name: Residential sales
segments.commentary: Q4 FY26 sales volume was 3.01 million sq ft (vs 1.42 million sq ft in Q4 FY25) at average realisation of INR11,787 per sq ft (up 37% YoY). FY26 volume was 7.25 million sq ft at INR10,213 per sq ft (up 21%).

segments.name: Handovers
segments.commentary: Handed over 1,301 homes (1.67 million sq ft) in Q4 FY26 and 3,747 homes (4.25 million sq ft) in FY26.

segments.name: Launches
segments.commentary: Launched three new projects (Purva SilverSky, Purva Northern Lights, Purva Estrella) and seven new phases in FY26, totalling 6.39 million sq ft. Northern Lights realisation is about INR10,700 per sq ft and it contributed INR1,100-1,200 crore to Q4 presales. Lokhandwala contributed slightly over INR800 crore in Q4.

segments.name: Commercial assets
segments.commentary: Aerocity has received OC and leasing has started; Zentech OC is expected within the month and is about 40-45% leased or sold. FY26 commercial sales and leasing was about 2.6 lakh sq ft.

segments.name: Starworth
segments.commentary: Not a reporting segment; order book is above INR2,000 crore and FY25 financials are on the website, with FY26 to follow.

guidance_outlook: FY27 presales target of about INR11,200 crore, of which about 48% from sustained sales and 52% from new launches; about INR7,000 crore expected from the South and the rest from West and Commercial.
Gross debt reduction target of about INR750 crore for FY27, excluding incremental borrowing for business development; scheduled repayment is INR836 crore this year.

Collections expected to grow in double digits in FY27; management suggested 45-50% of the INR7,400 crore sales from the big launches could be collected in the first year (exact figure to be shared offline).
Estimated surplus cash flow of INR19,290 crore: INR8,816 crore from ongoing projects, INR2,131 crore from exiting commercial assets, and INR8,343 crore from the launch pipeline.
Launch pipeline of 14.85 million sq ft with GDV of INR22,547 crore; Bandra launch expected between Dussehra and Diwali after members vacate by end-June.
capex_capacity: Land bank of about 56.48 million sq ft, of which about 21 million sq ft is earmarked for the launch guidance, leaving about 35 million sq ft.

FY26 business development added over 12 million sq ft and about INR15,200 crore GDV across six projects, including Chembur (INR2,100 crore GDV), Malabar Hills (INR2,700 crore), Hennur Road JD (INR1,300 crore), Baglagere JD (INR1,000 crore), Attibele 53.5 acres (INR4,800 crore) and Northern Bengaluru JD (INR3,300 crore).
Malabar Hills: development agreement complete, registration in about 45 days, approvals expected in 9-12 months, pricing INR115,000-120,000 per sq ft on carpet area.
Two under-construction assets delivered, totalling about 2 million sq ft; FY27 residential delivery guidance to be shared offline.
Commercial: planning new verticals including data centres, warehousing and retail (about 3 lakh sq ft retail in Thane), with NCR (Delhi, Noida, Gurugram) as the expansion focus; no timelines given.
demand_pricing: Management says the Bengaluru market is steady rather than frenzied, with about 30% of the last launch sold; AI and GCC demand is seen as supportive.
NRI demand held up after the strong launch quarter; management says rupee depreciation may attract outside money but is watching global uncertainty.
Construction costs are rising about 6-7% due to diesel prices; management says margins and contingencies absorb this for now.
Project margins: new launches target above 20% gross margin (Northern Lights about 20-21%, Purva Estrella slightly above 20%); plotted development 30-40% gross margin.
Housing sales in top 8 cities were about 84,800 units, with homes above INR10 million at about 53% of sales.

qa_highlights.question: Launch timing and confidence in the launch pipeline, including Bandra?
qa_highlights.answer: Bandra launch targeted between Dussehra and Diwali, with a GDV of about INR2,700 crore for the saleable portion. Management says most of the pipeline (INR22,547 crore) should launch despite past delays from Bengaluru approvals.

qa_highlights.question: Collection outlook for FY27 given weak YoY growth and flat Western collections?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said collections will grow in double digits, with about 45-50% of the FY26 sales expected to be collected in the first year; the exact figure will be shared offline.

qa_highlights.question: Why did interest expense rise to about INR600-650 crore, and how does the NCD accounting work?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said the increase reflects debt raised for business development, and that fair-value accounting for some instruments adds to P&L cost. Cost on that instrument is above 11.05%. Detailed working to follow offline.

qa_highlights.question: Does the INR750 crore debt reduction apply to gross or net debt?
qa_highlights.answer: Management confirmed it refers to gross debt, with scheduled repayment of INR836 crore this year; excess collections and project-level sweeps may add to that.

qa_highlights.question: Commercial leasing traction at Zentech and Aerocity?
qa_highlights.answer: Zentech is about 40-45% leased or sold before OC; Aerocity has many GCC RFPs of over 2 million sq ft and large deals are expected in the next couple of quarters.

risks_watch: Collections: FY26 collections grew only 15% against 55% presales growth, and the company has not given a collection number for FY27.
Interest cost of about INR600-650 crore on roughly INR3,900-4,000 crore gross debt; management is to provide reconciliation offline.
Launch execution risk in Bengaluru amid approval changes (e-Khata, Greater Bengaluru Authority) and the Bandra vacation timeline.
Cost inflation of 6-7% from diesel prices and geopolitical impact on the RBI's FY27 growth outlook (6.9%).
Delivery guidance for FY27 residential and the timing of Zentech OC and Aerocity leasing remain unquantified.
summary.management_tone: Confident on sales, launches and the FY27 presales target, but cautious on macro and cost risks. Management deferred several numerical questions (collections, interest reconciliation, FY27 delivery) to offline follow-up.
key_quotes: FY26 has been a landmark year for the company.
We are targeting a presales value of approximately INR 11,200 crores for FY26-27

On the balance sheet front, we are targeting a debt reduction of approximately INR 750 crores for FY26-27, excluding any incremental borrowing undertaken for strategic business development opportunities.

So whether it is AI, I would actually look at it as a positive thing for any place which is technology centric simply because AI also requires work and implementation and everything else that goes along with that.
